title: The Vocabulary That Doubles Your Conversion Rate
caption: Words change how people feel about buying. These 7 swaps work everywhere. Comment 'MOVE' and follow for the full list.
tips: Use 3 hashtags max. More looks desperate.
Post at evening local time (19:00-21:00) for max initial engagement.
End every video with the same follow CTA so it becomes a habit for viewers.
thumbnail: Split screen: red X words vs green check words, big bold '7 WORDS' in the middle.
script:
[HOOK] 5 words to never say in sales.
[PAIRS - rapid fire]
Don't say contract, instead say agreement - because people agreements are mutual, contracts feel one-sided.
Don't say sign, instead say authorize - authorizing feels like a choice, not a trap.
Don't say customer, instead say client - clients feel like partners, customers feel like numbers.
Don't say buy, instead say invest - people invest in value, not purchases.
Don't say cheap, instead say affordable - affordable feels smart, cheap feels risky.
[CLOSE] Your sales does not have to sound like everyone else's. Comment 'MOVE' and I will send you the full list.
Make sure you follow - it only goes to followers.
